prompt: Use the provided crop as the approved visual reference and recreate it as a clean production asset. This is a seamless surface texture: a tileable plate of deep cobalt blue printed PVC card stock, the face of a payphone card. Output a tileable texture plate with no objects, no text, no lettering, no rules, no lines, no vignette, no card edges, no corner radius, no drop shadow. Lighting perfectly even across the whole frame so the plate tiles without a visible seam. Keep the scuffing sparse and low contrast; the ground must read as one continuous colour. Do not add objects. Do not restyle. The texture fills the whole frame edge to edge.
